## Tabs, a running-agents card, and attachments in the composer

Nova Desktop 0.10.4 restyles the view tabs as a floating card, adds a Running agents card at the end of the viewbar, attaches files from the composer, and replaces the two composer dropdowns with icon chips.

### Added

- **Running agents**: a button at the right end of the viewbar opens a card listing the live turn — the chat's title, what it is doing, and a live dot. Clicking a row opens that chat. With nothing running it says "No agents running". Escape or a click outside closes it.
- **Attach files**: a paperclip in the composer opens the multi-select file picker and adds the chosen **paths** to the prompt as text you can edit before sending. Paths inside the open folder are written workspace-relative; anything else keeps its own absolute form. Every harness already reads a path it is given, so this works with nova, claude, codex, opencode, pi, commandcode and hermes without a protocol change.
- A new `pick_attachments` command, registered beside `pick_workspace`, so the frontend still needs no `dialog:*` capability.

### Changed

- The view tabs now read as one rounded card with the same surface, border and shadow as the sidebars. The shell itself stays square: only `.view-tabs` and `.view-tab` were dropped from the flat-UI rule that had been zeroing their radius.
- Auto approval and Agent personality are icon chips — a padlock that opens, and turns accent, when auto approval is on; a crew portrait or a people glyph for personality. The native `<select>` is still there, invisible over the icon, so the platform dropdown opens in place and keyboard and screen-reader behaviour is unchanged. High-contrast mode falls back to the visible native control.

### Validation

- New frontend tests for `attachmentPrompt`: empty draft, one separating space, quoted paths, no-op.
- New Rust test `attachment_labels_are_relative_inside_and_absolute_outside`, which caught a real defect: the workspace guard holds a canonical verbatim root while the picker returns a plain host path, so nothing inside the folder would have looked inside it. `attachment_label` now canonicalizes the candidate and keeps the readable form for paths outside.
- `npm run lint`, the frontend suite (113 tests), `npm run build`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -D warnings` and `npm run test:rust` (218 passed) all pass on this version.

### Not covered

- No automated check clicks the new card, the invisible select overlay or the paperclip's native dialog: the repo has no jsdom or app-browser harness, and the dialogs are compiled out of test builds.
- The card reports the single live turn. Team member turns live in a non-reactive ref in App, so a team run shows one row rather than one per member.
